gen-gf-yomogi-fs-spline-sans: Spline Sans leaves wide gaps where curves meet stems, so it reads open and modern. Yomogi's hand-drawn, single-width strokes add a personal wobble above it, and the sans keeps everything underneath tidy.
gen-gf-yomogi-fs-synonym: Synonym lays down a plain sans stripe of constant ink, with generous openings in every curve, and it reads dependably. Yomogi adds a hand-drawn, friendly voice on top.
gen-gf-yomogi-outfit: Cable-bent and friendly, with a hand-drawn lead. Yomogi's crescent-wrench c brings the personality, while Outfit's curves stop short of closing and carry the sans-serif text.
gen-gf-yomogi-plus-jakarta-sans: Friendly, then precise: that is the whole conversation here. Make Yomogi small and its hand-drawn charm gets lost, while Plus Jakarta Sans stays crisp with its curve endings held well apart.
gen-gf-yomogi-sora: A crescent-wrench c gives Yomogi a hand-drawn, single-width look that is hard to miss at large sizes in short bursts. Sora follows with geometric precision, its c and s kept widely parted and no swell at the corners.
gen-gf-yomogi-space-grotesk: Yomogi writes in friendly, hand-drawn strokes of single width, with a crescent-wrench c that feels personal. And Space Grotesk answers in geometric ribbons whose open counters breathe, keeping the page tidy.
gen-gf-yuji-hentaigana-akari-fs-amulya: Relaxed handwriting with big side gaps and round, open forms. And Amulya continues in a contemporary sans-serif whose generous curve openings keep a longer passage easy on the eye.
gen-gf-yuji-hentaigana-akari-fs-neco: Neco is a dignified serif whose strokes swell gently from hairline to stem, and its letters never pinch shut. Yuji Hentaigana Akari's relaxed hand suggests going larger.
gen-gf-yuji-hentaigana-akari-fs-plein: Big side gaps between round, hand-drawn letters give Yuji Hentaigana Akari its relaxed, personal look. And Plein is reliable and clean, with a clear channel leading into each round shape.
gen-gf-yuji-hentaigana-akari-fs-recia: Recia is a sharp serif with light modulation that shows mainly up close, and its openings stay generous. Recia's authority meets Yuji Hentaigana Akari's relaxed handwriting, and that pairing of warmth and polish is the best thing here.
